updates.description_html:
You can now use column aliases in GoogleSQL. This feature lets you define an alias for an expression in the SELECT clause of a SQL query and immediately reference that alias within the same SELECT list or in the WHERE clause of the same query block.

Column aliases also streamline the migration of workloads from other data warehouses such as Snowflake and Teradata, by supporting their syntax.

This feature is generally available, and is opt-in only. To use column aliases, you must first enable the feature.

updates.description_html:
BigQuery offers TimesFM 3.0, a built-in time series forecasting model that implements Google Research's open source TimesFM model. You can use TimesFM 3.0 with the following functions:

  • Use AI.FORECAST to perform time series forecasting. In addition to univariate forecasting, you can now perform multivariate forecasting that predicts values for multiple time series based on historical values and additional covariates.
  • Use AI.EVALUATE to perform univariate time series evaluation.
  • Use AI.DETECT_ANOMALIES to perform univariate time series anomaly detection.

Conversational analytics in BigQuery also supports using TimesFM 3.0 with these functions.

To try using the TimesFM 3.0 model for multivariate forecasting with the AI.FORECAST function, see Forecast a single time series with a TimesFM multivariate model and Forecast multiple time series with a TimesFM multivariate model.

The TimesFM 3.0 model is in Preview.

For more information, see the GCP-2026-056 security bulletin.
